title: Exact shifts for the pinned projection followed by a map to the tensor unit
statement:
Let $f:Z	o Y$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-scheme]. Fix derived categories of their module sheaves in one localization universe, and derived categories of modules on every open of $Y$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Use the recorded derived pullback $L=Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], derived direct image $R_0=Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and K-flat derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Assume the full subcategories $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ and $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Z)$ are triangulated for their induced shifts and ambient distinguished triangles. Assume $R_0$ carries quasi-coherent objects to quasi-coherent objects, and $\mathcal O_Y$ is quasi-coherent. Fix $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Z)$, and assume $LK\otimes E$ is quasi-coherent for every $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$. Give $L$ a specified monoidal structure and fix $a:L\dashv R_0$. Put $Q(K)=LK\otimes E$ as a quasi-coherent functor, and let $R$ be the quasi-coherent restriction of $R_0$. Fix $\epsilon:RE	o\mathcal O_Y$ and a natural transformation $
u:Q\circ R\Rightarrow\mathrm{id}$, where $Q\circ R$ denotes applying $Q$ first and then $R$. For every $K$, suppose there is an isomorphism $p_K:R_0(LK\otimes E)\cong K\otimes R_0E$ satisfying $p_K^{-1}=a.\operatorname{homEquiv}(\mu_L(K,R_0E)^{-1}\mathbin{;} (LK\otimes\epsilon^a_E))$ and whose composite with $K\otimes\epsilon$ and the right unitor equals the ambient map of $
u_K$. Here semicolon denotes composition in the order written. Then there are coherent integer shift structures on $Q$ and $R$ for which both functors preserve distinguished triangles and $
u$ commutes with every integer shift. This statement makes no assertion about a right adjoint of $R$, and involves no comparison map to such a right adjoint.

proof.text: Obtain the exact pullback and unital natural tensor shift structures from lem-sc-derived-monoidal-pullback-unital-shift. Use Mathlib Adjunction.rightAdjointCommShift and commShift_of_leftAdjoint to construct the uniquely compatible shift on the fixed direct image functor. Adjunction.isTriangulated_rightAdjoint proves direct-image exactness from pullback exactness. The full-subcategory lift instances then make Q and R exact for their induced shifts.

Flip the inverse tensorator natural transformation and form a.rightAdjointProjectionMap at E. Apply the upstream Adjunction.commShift_rightAdjointProjectionMap_app, using inverse-tensorator shift compatibility and tensor morphism compatibility on Z for the adjunction counit. Precompose this map with the inclusion of quasi-coherent objects to get a shift-compatible transformation t.

The pinning hypothesis identifies t at K with pf.inv. Thus every t component is invertible, giving IsIso t and shift compatibility of inv t by NatTrans.CommShift.of_isIso. Compose the lift comparison isomorphisms and functor associators to identify (Q composed with R) composed with the inclusion with the ambient composite. Their shift compatibility follows from the Mathlib liftCompιIso and associator compatibility instances.

Tensor epsilon followed by the right unitor commutes with shifts by the Y tensor morphism and right-unitor clauses of lem-sc-derived-monoidal-pullback-unital-shift. Componentwise, cancel only the invertible pf.inv to identify (inv t).app K with pf.hom. The assumed component formula for nu proves that its image under the inclusion is the composite of the lift comparison, inv t, tensor epsilon and right unitor (with functor unitors to align endpoints). Compositions preserve CommShift. NatTrans.CommShift.of_whiskerRight detects it through the faithful inclusion. No epsilon or nu component is cancelled.
